Maple Street Café — Weekday Lunch (11 A.M.–2 P.M.)

Soup of the Day with bread — $6
Grilled Chicken Sandwich — $9
Garden Salad (add chicken for $3) — $7
Veggie Wrap — $8

Lunch Combo: any sandwich or wrap with a cup of soup — $12
All lunch items are available for takeout. Weekend brunch menu is different.

questions.stem: How much would a customer pay for a veggie wrap with a cup of soup?
questions.explanation: The "Lunch Combo: any sandwich or wrap with a cup of soup" costs $12.

questions.stem: What is suggested about the café?
options: A. It serves lunch only on weekends.
B. It does not allow takeout orders.
C. It offers different food on Saturdays and Sundays.
D. It closes at 11 A.M. on weekdays.
questions.explanation: The menu is for weekdays, and it notes "Weekend brunch menu is different."
